OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Follows the input after the delay
1 while a switching time is active
1 while a calendar entry is active

PULSE_GENERATOR.NAME: Pulse generator
PULSE_GENERATOR.DESCRIPTION: While enabled the output alternates between 1 for the on time and 0 for the off time

ON.NAME: On time [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 1 phase, at least 0.1 s

OFF.NAME: Off time [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 0 phase, at least 0.1 s

CLICK_DETECTION.NAME: Click detection
CLICK_DETECTION.DESCRIPTION: Tells single, double and triple clicks and a long press of a push button apart. The button must send 1 on press and 0 on release

SINGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse after a single click (one click window late)

LONG.DESCRIPTION: 1 from the long press time until the button is released

CLICK_WINDOW.NAME: Click window [ms]
CLICK_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Maximum time between two clicks of a double or triple click

LONG_PRESS.NAME: Long press [ms]
LONG_PRESS.DESCRIPTION: Hold time for a long press, 0 = off (for buttons that send no release)
